body:
Can a generic script-transport change eliminate argument-limit aborts while preserving native validation behavior? Follow-up to #28, with related earlier failures in #27.

**Evidence:** #28 records 33 `OSError/errno7` events across MACS, Matchms, Cobrapy and OHIF. The pinned upstream executor embeds scripts and patches in one `bash -lc` argument. A [small synthetic probe](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/f4407421/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/history-wide/task-reviews/upstream-argument-transport-probe-20261023.json) reproduced the operating-system limit without Docker or our resource wrapper. Failed original script bytes were not captured, so exact per-PR sizes and recovery remain unknown.

**First investigation:** inspect the pinned execution API and compare stdin/file transport designs. Prepare a minimal upstream-compatible change with bounded deterministic tests for large payloads, quoting, Unicode, exact content, working directory/environment, output/exit status, and timeout/cleanup semantics. Avoid introducing shell interpolation of patch content or leaking files across executions.

**Live comparison proposal:** predeclare a small representative set from original failing identities and at least one previously successful control. Compare identical source/test contracts and environment reconstruction with only transport changed. No manual patch reduction, candidate bypass, dependency repair or added model call. Distinguish removal of the transport exception from producing a valid positive control pair.

**Success criteria:** exact payload delivery beyond the old argument boundary, unchanged ordinary-command behavior, complete cleanup and reproducible paired outcomes. Large-diff HTTP406 acquisition failures and malformed metadata responses are separate problems, outside this transport comparison. [Source binding](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/f4407421/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/history-wide/task-reviews/upstream-argument-transport-source-binding-20261023.json).

**Execution and reporting:** initial evidence/source review has $0 model spend and launches no remote jobs. Before execution, checkpoint exact cases, revisions, configurations, resource bounds and a cumulative cost allowance; do not treat #28’s unused ceiling as a fresh budget. Use the official pipeline with explicitly justified, general changes only; no added LLM/Codex repairs of individual tasks or environments. Preserve baseline and comparison results separately, archive eligible evidence with verified readback, and clean up owned resources. Keep the body a concise current summary and detailed investigation logs in comments. Research branches remain separate from main.
